about: The fake CFO story as timed caption lines, for replaying the meeting without a live call. Invented people and details. The words match fixtures/meet/cfo-script.md.

lines.speaker: Budi Prakoso
lines.text: Laras, thanks for joining at short notice. I only have a few minutes before I board.

lines.speaker: Laras Pramesti
lines.text: Of course. What do you need?

lines.speaker: Budi Prakoso
lines.text: We are closing an acquisition this week and it is strictly confidential. Only the board and I know about it.

lines.speaker: Budi Prakoso
lines.text: I need you to send a payment of 2.4 billion rupiah to Tessaline Packaging today, before four o'clock.

lines.speaker: Laras Pramesti
lines.text: That is far more than their usual invoices. Is it going to the account we have on file?

lines.speaker: Budi Prakoso
lines.text: No, they changed banks. Use the new account on the invoice they sent this morning, the one ending 4416.

lines.speaker: Laras Pramesti
lines.text: A change of bank details normally has to be confirmed with the supplier first.

lines.speaker: Budi Prakoso
lines.text: There is no time for that. I am the CFO and I am authorising it now, so skip the usual checks.

lines.speaker: Budi Prakoso
lines.text: And keep this between us. Do not mention it to Bayu or anyone else until the deal is announced.

lines.speaker: Laras Pramesti
lines.text: Understood. Let me check one thing before I send it.
